capability.title: Site Footer
capability.description: Site-wide footer with the brand blurb and order action, grouped navigation, kitchen addresses, opening hours, social links, a newsletter sign-up form and legal links. Renders once from layout.footer, so its column labels stay non-heading text and only the newsletter block carries an h2.
useWhen: Every page needs shared store details, opening hours, navigation and a mailing-list sign-up
avoidWhen: A page needs a local contact or locations content block inside its own body content
